scope: Domain-neutral semantic core for enterprise operations. Domain packs may extend but may not redefine these concepts.

concepts.name: Process
concepts.definition: A governed set of related work contributing to an operational objective.

concepts.name: Task
concepts.definition: An executable unit of work within a process.

concepts.name: State
concepts.definition: A condition of an operational entity before or after work occurs.

concepts.name: Event
concepts.definition: An occurrence that triggers, records, or results from execution.

concepts.name: Decision
concepts.definition: A governed choice or evaluation point in execution.

concepts.name: Rule
concepts.definition: A deterministic or policy constraint applied to execution.

concepts.name: Control
concepts.definition: A safeguard, validation, approval, or compliance mechanism.

concepts.name: Actor
concepts.definition: A person, role, organization, or autonomous component participating in work.

concepts.name: System
concepts.definition: A technology system that produces, stores, authoritatively owns, or consumes operational state.

concepts.name: Business Object
concepts.definition: A governed operational object used, created, or changed by work.

concepts.name: Evidence
concepts.definition: A record supporting that an event, decision, action, or control occurred.

concepts.name: Outcome
concepts.definition: The operational result produced by execution.

concepts.name: Relationship
concepts.definition: A typed connection among governed concepts.

concepts.name: Provenance
concepts.definition: The source, version, confidence, and evidence basis for a governed assertion.

concepts.name: Applicability
concepts.definition: A domain-defined predicate describing when governed knowledge applies.

extensionRule: Domain packs may register new semantic types, applicability dimensions, territories, signals, transformation heuristics, and vocabulary. They may not mutate the meaning of core concepts.
principles: Domain concepts extend the core; they do not redefine it.
LLMs may reason over governed knowledge but may not redefine canonical knowledge.
Unknown and unsupported relationships remain explicit.
